description: A bright yellow cloth lies spread out on the bed in front of you, with a neatly folded light blue cloth to the right near the pillow. The left hand reaches in from the left edge to pinch and lift the near corner of the yellow cloth while the right hand comes in from the lower right to help fold it over into a long rectangle, then both hands tuck and fold it into a smaller bundle; the right hand lifts the folded yellow cloth and places it on top of the blue cloth, releasing it to form a stacked pair.
